full_prompt_en: A square, moody painterly seascape shows a short row of old white houses beside a still harbor under a heavy clouded sky. The houses occupy the left side of the frame, with dark pitched roofs, several chimneys, small black windows, and two narrow doors catching faint warm color. Their irregular plaster walls stand on a low stone quay that projects toward the middle of the water. A small boat floats just beyond the quay at the center-right, its dark hull nearly merging with the gray surface. Across the upper half, layered charcoal and blue-gray cloud cover opens around a pale golden glow near the center. Tiny birds appear as dark strokes against the brighter sky. The horizon remains low and indistinct, allowing the sky and its reflection to dominate the view. In the lower half, calm water carries broken vertical reflections of the houses and a brighter orange-gold streak below the opening in the clouds. Near the foreground, scattered dark marks and fine ripples disturb the otherwise glassy surface. The treatment is neither sharply photographic nor freely abstract: textured brushes soften the building edges and blend mist through the sky, while the rooflines, quay, and boat remain recognizable. The main light filters through the clouds from behind the village, leaving the house fronts dim and illuminating patches of water from above. Warm highlights are sparse but vivid against the cool slate palette. The overall composition is hushed and balanced, with the clustered buildings on the left countered by open reflective water and a luminous break in the weather.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形、带绘画感的情绪化海景描绘一小排旧白房屋立在平静港湾旁，上方压着厚重阴云。房屋占据画面左侧，有深色斜屋顶、几根烟囱、小小的黑窗和两扇带微弱暖色的窄门。不规则的灰泥墙立在低矮石码头上，码头向水面中央伸出。一艘小船漂在码头外、画面中央偏右处，深色船体几乎与灰色水面融为一体。上半幅层叠的炭黑和蓝灰色云层在中央附近裂开，露出浅金色光芒。细小鸟影如深色笔痕，掠过较亮的天空。地平线低而模糊，让天空和倒影主导视野。下半幅平静水面承载房屋的破碎竖向倒影，以及云隙下方更明亮的橙金色光带。前景附近，散落的暗痕与细小波纹扰动本来光滑如镜的水面。处理既非极锐利摄影，也非完全抽象：带纹理的笔刷软化建筑边缘，让薄雾融入天空，同时屋顶线、码头和小船仍可辨认。主要光线从村舍后方透过云层，使房屋正面较暗，并从上方照亮局部水面。暖色亮点虽少，却在冷石板色系中格外鲜明。整体构图安静而平衡，左侧聚集的房屋与开阔反光水域及天气中的发亮裂口相互呼应。
style_prompt_en: Painterly atmospheric rendering relies on layered slate, charcoal, and blue-gray washes with small amber and pale gold breaks. Soft, rubbed edges and grainy brush marks let forms recede into mist, while a few darker linear contours keep their silhouettes legible. Broad quiet areas of muted color are interrupted by narrow vertical reflections and sparse high-contrast glints. Diffused light passes through an opening above and scatters across lower surfaces, producing a deep tonal range without hard graphic outlines. The arrangement leaves generous breathing space around a compact cluster of shapes, giving the image a still, weathered, contemplative character.
style_prompt_zh: 带绘画感的氛围表现依靠石板灰、炭黑和蓝灰色层叠薄涂，只在局部裂隙出现琥珀色与浅金色。柔和擦抹边缘和颗粒笔痕让形体退入薄雾，少量深色线性轮廓仍维持剪影可读。大块安静的低饱和色面被狭窄竖向倒影与稀疏强反差亮点打断。漫射光从上方开口透过并洒向下方表面，形成丰富明暗层级，却没有坚硬图形轮廓。构图在紧凑形状群周围留下宽裕呼吸空间，使图像安静、风化而沉思。
theme_en: Old waterfront houses beneath a clouded sky at dusk
theme_zh: 暮色阴云下的旧海滨房屋
name: David Mould
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
